_comment: Amazon FireTV configuration — the actual app is the Android APK in /android/. This file documents FireTV-specific settings and Appstore submission checklist.

app.name: Plajah
app.description: Run your own 24/7 streaming TV channel. Music, film, books and worlds from one creator identity.

androidManifest.mediaSession: PlajahMediaService — enables Alexa media voice commands

voiceSearch.note: Register global search intent in Appstore developer console to appear in Fire TV search results

xRayIntegration.note: X-Ray (cast/crew overlay during video) — Phase 2 feature

alexaVoiceControl.note: Handled by PlajahMediaService via Android MediaSession. Alexa commands: play/pause/skip/ask Plajah to play [artist]

picture_in_picture.note: Add android:supportsPictureInPicture=true to MainActivity in AndroidManifest when ready

appstoreSubmission.contentDeclaration: Streaming music and video content — user-uploaded, verified against rights dashboard

uiGuidelines.safeZone: Keep all critical UI within inner 90% of screen (TV overscan)
